name: Classic Tattoo

address.source: Consistent across jacksonvillejive.com, Yelp listing title, tattooswizard.com, guidetoflorida.com and the storefront photo itself

email_source: Recurring across independent search-engine aggregations (Booksy category page summary, tattooswizard.com summary) as the public contact email; not verified via a direct mailto link on an owned page (business has no website). Treated as reliable given repeated independent corroboration but flagged for human sanity-check before send.

domains_tried: classictattoojax.com (does not resolve / not registered to this business)
own_site_check.note: classictattootx.com exists but is a distinct, unrelated business in Texas (name coincidence only). No Squarespace/Wix/GlossGenius/Booksy microsite found either; Instagram (@classictattoojax) and Facebook (facebook.com/classictattoojax) are the only public web presences.

artists_tagged: @scab_vendor (likely a supply/vendor tag, not a tattoo artist)
instagram.access_note: Instagram's private web_profile_info API (instagram.com/api/v1/users/web_profile_info) was attempted 3 times with the standard x-ig-app-id header per pipeline instructions; the outbound proxy returned a hard block each time ('Asset asset://laser.provider/ig_business_category_subvertical has been deleted') rather than real IG data. Direct WebFetch of instagram.com and instagram.com/.../embed/ also hit login walls with no usable content. Per pipeline fallback rule, pivoted to a public read-only Instagram mirror (imginn.com) which surfaced the bio text above and real CDN photo/video URLs for the same account.

facebook.source: Fetched via r.jina.ai reader proxy against facebook.com/classictattoojax/reviews (direct WebFetch/curl hit Facebook's login wall with no content). Reader proxy surfaced the public review widget: '100% recommend (24 Reviews)' plus one real named review, reproduced verbatim below.

rating_source: jacksonvillejive.com local tattoo-shop directory entry for Classic Tattoo (588 Edgewood Ave S): '5 stars ratings, based on 90 Google user reviews'. Cross-confirmed by independent web search summaries citing the same 5.0/90 figures. Facebook page separately shows '100% recommend, 24 Reviews' (distinct metric, also used on site).

reviews_verbatim.name: Lisa Fenzel
reviews_verbatim.date: May 1 (year not shown on card, recent)
reviews_verbatim.text: One of the best tattoos I ever got today. Will be back turned out exactly how I wanted it thank you John 🤩

reviews_note: Real effort was made to find 3-5 verbatim quotes per the brief: Yelp business page returned HTTP 403 on every attempt (direct curl, WebFetch, r.jina.ai reader, m.yelp.com) so its reviews were never accessible. Google's own review snippets were not retrievable through web search or direct Google Search/Maps fetches (Maps requires JS; Search returned no literal quoted snippets). Facebook's full page is login-walled directly, but the r.jina.ai reader proxy exposed the public reviews widget, yielding exactly one real, verbatim, attributed review (Lisa Fenzel). Per instructions, this single real quote was used rather than inventing additional ones; the aggregate proof (5.0/90 Google, 100%/24 Facebook) is shown prominently alongside it to compensate.

hours.source: Consistent across jacksonvillejive.com and independent web search summaries (Yelp listing metadata surfaced in search results).

payment: Cash only (confirmed by jacksonvillejive.com summary and tattooswizard.com: 'operates on a cash-only basis')
walk_ins: Always welcome; visible directly on the storefront window signage ('WALK-INS ALWAYS WEL[COME]') photographed for this build, and repeated across every secondary source.
services_note: No fixed price list found or expected: tattoo studios price by size/placement/detail after a consult. This is stated honestly on-site (Styles section) with a 'no fixed price list, honest quote before the needle starts' framing instead of invented prices. Styles offered were inferred from the artist roster and curated gallery photos: American Traditional (bold color, classic imagery), Black & Grey, Blackwork & Ornamental (geometric/mandala), and Custom Flash (hand-painted sheets, one sheet by artist Justin Collette was downloaded and used in the About section).

artists.name: Justin Collette
artists.note: Signed flash sheet ('J.Collette / Justin Collette, Jacksonville, Florida') recovered and used as a real studio asset

language_source: US business in Jacksonville, FL. Instagram bio and all captions/reviews found (Facebook recommendation from Lisa Fenzel) are in English. No Spanish-language signage, captions or reviews found anywhere.

brand_vibe.reasoning: Traditional American tattoo studio: bold ink, black storefront signage, gold/red flash-art palette. Dark base (templates/dark, Mizu ejemplar) fits the genre far better than a light/cream base.
brand_vibe.palette_name: classic (new palette, not reused from mizu/amani/mare/alea/pausa/eme)
brand_vibe.derivation: Gold/brass (accent-deep, accent-mid) and deep rust-red (accent-soft) pulled directly from the real curated photos: aged-gold lamp and dagger hilts, red suns and roses in the flash art and finished tattoos, warm black storefront.

images_downloaded.source: 10 of 11 photos came from the business' own Instagram feed (@classictattoojax), retrieved via the public read-only mirror imginn.com after Instagram's private web_profile_info API was hard-blocked by the outbound proxy after 3 attempts (see instagram.access_note above); 1 photo (storefront.jpg) came from a Google Maps business photo surfaced by jacksonvillejive.com's directory listing (lh5.googleusercontent.com CDN link, downloaded directly).
images_downloaded.resize_tool: Pillow (PIL) was found installed under /usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages after an initial import failure resolved itself; used to batch-resize every image to max width 1000px (quality 82, matching the pipeline's `sips -Z 1000` guidance) since ImageMagick/sips were not available in this environment.

images_downloaded.curation_notes: Every downloaded candidate was viewed individually before selection. Excluded: 1 flash sheet depicting nude pin-up imagery (adult content, unsuitable for a cold-outreach demo) and 1 blurry/glitch-filtered mid-session photo of an artist tattooing (does not meet the 'no process shots, no low-quality screenshots' rule). All 11 used images verified with `file` as real JPEG data >100KB, no 0-byte or corrupt files, none are selfies or mid-procedure close-ups.

quality_gate_caveats: Only 1 verbatim review quote was recoverable (Yelp fully blocked, Google review snippets not retrievable, Facebook mostly login-walled). Compensated on-site with prominent real aggregate stats (5.0/90 Google, 100%/24 Facebook) next to the single quote.

email is a strong-confidence inference from repeated independent aggregator citations, not a scraped mailto: link from an owned page (business has none). Recommend a quick human sanity check before any send.
No fixed pricing exists or was found; site states this honestly and drives to a phone call/walk-in instead of inventing prices.
No official logo file was available; nav/footer use a simple text/CSS 'CT' monogram instead of an logo, consistent with prior no-logo builds in this pipeline (e.g. oddjobrob).
